title: Read committed usage documentation
responsibility: Reads expected usage examples from one entity’s committed Markdown document without borrowing another revision.

inputs.name: hydrateUnitDocumentation.tree
inputs.description: An object exposing the read method used to retrieve a documentation file’s text. It is needed when a unit has a documentation path.

inputs.name: hydrateUnitDocumentation.units
inputs.description: Mutable unit views whose declared documentation paths are to be read. Entries without a path are left unchanged; entries with a path are read concurrently and their documentation is replaced with the parsed result.

inputs.name: unitDocumentation.text
inputs.description: Markdown from which the parser extracts exactly one harness-examples JSON block for the requested unit. The text is limited to 262,144 characters; the block requires schemaVersion 1 and 1–64 examples, and optional setup is trimmed and limited to 1–32,000 characters.

inputs.name: unitDocumentation.unitId
inputs.description: The unit identifier compared with the JSON block’s unitId. A mismatch produces a gap result.

inputs.name: unitDocumentation.path
inputs.description: The path copied verbatim into the returned documentation. It defaults to the empty string when omitted.

inputs.name: readUnitDocumentation.tree
inputs.description: An object exposing the read method used to retrieve a documentation file’s text. It is needed when a unit has a documentation path.

inputs.name: readUnitDocumentation.unit
inputs.description: The unit identifier and its optional documentation path. Without a path the operation returns undefined; with a path it reads that file from the supplied tree.

outputs.name: unitDocumentation
outputs.description: Parsed examples and optional setup with the supplied path and text, or an empty examples list with a gap reason when the document cannot be used. A valid document has exactly one matching harness-examples block and is at most 262,144 characters.

outputs.name: readUnitDocumentation
outputs.description: Resolves to the parsed document, including a gap result if reading or parsing fails, or to undefined when no documentation path was supplied. Read failures are caught and represented as a gap result.

outputs.name: hydrateUnitDocumentation
outputs.description: Resolves after all units with documentation paths have been read and their documentation fields replaced; units without a path are unchanged. It returns no value.
